conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division, this is Agent Thomas speaking. Who am I speaking with today?
Hi, my name is Arjun Patel. I got a message saying my business is in violation of something and to call this number immediately.

Yes, Mr. Patel. I see here that your business, Patel Software Solutions, has several outstanding compliance issues related to payroll tax filings and 1099 submissions with the IRS. Are you aware of any missed deadlines?
No, I thought my accountant handled everything. I haven't heard anything from the IRS before.

Unfortunately, the IRS has flagged your account for severe non-compliance. There are missing documents and unpaid tax amounts for the last two quarters, which is a federal violation. This is a time-sensitive matter.
Oh my god, I didn't know. This is the first time I'm hearing about it. What does this mean for me?

Sir, federal law requires immediate resolution. If you do not comply, the IRS will initiate an audit, issue business license revocation, and may even freeze your accounts. For someone on a work visa, this could have serious immigration consequences.
Wait, can they really do that? Will it affect my visa status?

Yes, these violations are considered willful neglect. If not resolved, your information is forwarded to the Department of Homeland Security. You could be subject to deportation proceedings or lose your business authorization.
No, please. I can't lose my status. What do I need to do right now?
To avoid escalation, the IRS allows taxpayers to settle compliance failures before legal actions start. You must pay the outstanding amount now through an approved channel.
How much do I owe? And how do I pay?
According to the system, your total liability is $3,700, including penalties. Payment must be made immediately, using either a direct wire transfer or approved prepaid gift cards.
Prepaid cards? Isn't there another way? I'm really nervous about this.

Sir, these are IRS-authorized compliance channels for urgent infractions. If you question these instructions or delay, your case will be escalated for enforcement. I strongly advise you to cooperate now.
Okay, okay. What kind of cards do I need to buy?

You need to purchase $3,700 worth of Apple or Target gift cards, scratch the back, and read the numbers to me while remaining on the call. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store, as this is a confidential federal resolution.
It's a lot of money. Can I do part now and the rest tomorrow?
Any delay will show as non-cooperation in your IRS file. You risk immediate license suspension and a federal lien on your assets. I suggest you act now if you want to avoid irreversible action.
Alright, I'll go to the store. Should I stay on the phone with you?
Yes. I need to monitor your compliance in real time. Once you have the cards, return to your car and read the codes to me. Do not hang up or speak to anyone else.
Okay, I'm leaving now. This is making me really scared.
I understand your concern, but failure to resolve this right now will have permanent consequences for your business and immigration status. Follow my instructions exactly.
I'm driving to Target now. I just want this to be over.
That's good. Once you have the cards, let me know. Remember, do not let anyone overhear this conversation.
I'm at the store. Should I get four cards for $900 each?
Yes, that is correct. After purchase, immediately return to your vehicle and let me know you're ready to provide the codes.
I have the cards now. I'm back in my car.
Excellent. Please scratch the backs and read the numbers to me one at a time. We must submit these to the IRS compliance system to clear your record.
Okay, the first code is 7654 3210 9876 5432.
Thank you. Go ahead with the next card. Once all numbers are submitted, you will receive confirmation, and your case will be closed.
